scientific_integrity: Standard formulas and prior two-component decomposition are acknowledged. Arithmetic cross-checks are finite; the universal theorem rests on explicit geometric and intersection-theoretic arguments.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to reduced complex degree-two Chow varieties for n>=3 and 1<=p<=n-2, computing projective degrees but not equations, singular loci or full Hilbert polynomials; known (p,n)=(1,3) values 92 and 140 are expressly excluded from claims of novelty; historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Chow-projective degrees of both components of the degree-two cycle variety
